question: By whom was the 'Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam' tree plantation campaign launched throughout the country on the World Environment Day (5th June 2024)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 'Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam' tree plantation campaign was launched by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi.
 
• The campaign was initiated on World Environment Day, 5th June 2024, to promote environmental conservation.
 
• It aims to encourage citizens to plant trees in honor of their mothers, fostering a personal connection to tree planting.
 
• The initiative seeks to increase the green cover across the country, contributing to climate change mitigation and ecological balance.
 
• This campaign is part of broader efforts by the government to enhance environmental sustainability and awareness among the population.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Environment Day:**

 
 
• Celebrated annually on 5th June, it is the United Nations' principal vehicle for encouraging awareness and action for the protection of the environment.
 
• The theme for World Environment Day 2024 focuses on ecosystem restoration.
 
• Countries around the world participate by organizing various activities aimed at promoting environmental protection.
 
 
 
• **Tree Plantation:**
 
 
• Tree planting is a crucial activity for enhancing biodiversity and combating climate change.
 
• Trees absorb carbon dioxide, produce oxygen, and provide habitat for wildlife.
 
• They also help in preventing soil erosion and maintaining water cycles.
 
 
 
• **Climate Change Mitigation:**
 
 
• Refers to efforts to reduce or prevent the emission of greenhouse gases.
 
• Strategies include renewable energy sources, energy efficiency, and reforestation.
 
• Tree planting is a natural method to sequester carbon dioxide from the atmosphere.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Sustainability:**
 
 
• Involves making responsible decisions that will reduce negative impacts on the environment.
 
• It aims to conserve natural resources and protect global ecosystems to support health and well-being, now and in the future.
 
• Practices include reducing waste, conserving water, and supporting renewable energy sources.
